confidence_reason: Label text and growth rates verify; attributing the growth gap to the label is an inference, so the dollar figure is illustrative.
mechanism: Payers can require a cheap Humira biosimilar first, and the label confirms Rinvoq comes after it in most rheumatology indications, so Rinvoq's volume depends on TNF failures and grows slower than Skyrizi's.
part2_hook: Supports moving Rinvoq earlier in line through new indications (vitiligo, alopecia areata) rather than more TNF-switch promotion.
